relationships.subject: vedolizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: It specifically binds to α4β7 integrin, which is primarily expressed on the surface of memory T lymphocytes

relationships.subject: skewed X chromosome inactivation
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings confirmed that females carrying pathogenic ELF4 mutations may develop DEX phenotype due to non-random X chromosome inactivation.

key_findings: Three female patients heterozygous for pathogenic ELF4 variants developed DEX (oral/colonic ulcers) with skewed X chromosome inactivation.
Vedolizumab and exclusive enteral nutrition offered additional treatment options.
